title: Forge DOT Framework Enhancements
change_driver: DOT Framework integration (Decomposition, Orchestration, Trajectories) with Tuner adaptive learning loop

summary.goal: Enhance Forge to support the DOT Framework by adding budget enforcement, model routing, retry ladder, confidence handling, parallelism limits, dependency resolution, and Tuner integration for adaptive learning.
summary.background: The DOT Framework (docs/architecture/03-orchestration-forge.md, docs/forge-knobs-analysis.md) identifies missing orchestration capabilities that compound when combined: execution budgets, recovery strategies, model selection, and confidence-based control flow. Tuner (packages/tuner/) provides the adaptive learning loop that observes outcomes and optimizes these knobs over time.
impact_scope: packages/forge-core/src/storage/ - New tables for budgets, metrics

strengths: Run/Task state machine with clear status transitions
Questions with blocking levels and priority scoring
Recovery service with orphan detection and retry on restart
gaps: No model selection logic (static CLI config only)
No parallelism control (all ready tasks execute immediately)
Confidence captured but unused in control flow
No outcome emission for Tuner learning

changes_required.title: ExecutionPolicy Schema
changes_required.description: Add ExecutionPolicy type to control budgets, retry, parallelism, and replan triggers per run

acceptance_criteria.description: ExecutionPolicy has budgets: { per_task_time_seconds, per_task_token_limit, total_cost_limit_usd }
ExecutionPolicy has retry: { max_retries_per_task, backoff, backoff_base_seconds, include_failure_analysis }
ExecutionPolicy has parallelism: { max_concurrent_tasks, prefer_sequential_in_scope }
ExecutionPolicy has replan: { on_cascade_failure, threshold_blocked_tasks }
ExecutionPolicy has confidence: { escalation_threshold, review_threshold }
Run entity extended with execution_policy field

changes_required.research_basis: METR 2025: P(success) ~= (0.5)^(T/50min) - 5min per task budget recommended

changes_required.title: Budget Enforcement Service
changes_required.description: Track and enforce token/time/cost budgets per task and per run

acceptance_criteria.description: BudgetService tracks tokens_used, cost_usd, time_seconds per task

Budget exhaustion triggers configured action (pause, abort, or warn)
checkBudget(task_id) returns { ok, remaining, warning_level }
Budget updates emit trajectory events for observability

changes_required.research_basis: Research shows 36% silent failure rate without validation - budget tracking helps detect runaway tasks

changes_required.title: Retry Ladder (Recovery Strategies)
changes_required.description: Extend recovery beyond simple retry to include revise, rollback, branch, escalate

acceptance_criteria.description: RecoveryStrategy type supports: retry, revise, rollback, branch, escalate, skip
Default retry: 3 attempts with exponential backoff (base 30s)
Revise includes failure context in retry prompt (+20-30% improvement per Reflexion)
Escalate creates human gate after max retries exhausted
handleTaskFailure() selects strategy from config

changes_required.research_basis: Reflexion 2023: Self-correction with failure analysis improves performance +20-30%

changes_required.title: Confidence Threshold Handling
changes_required.description: Use captured confidence scores in control flow decisions

acceptance_criteria.description: Confidence < 0.3 fails task immediately
Confidence < 0.5 triggers clarification or rerun
Confidence >= 0.5 allows task to continue normally
Confidence thresholds configurable in ExecutionPolicy
Low confidence events captured in trajectory for learning

changes_required.research_basis: Multi-Agent Taxonomy 2025: 98% of silent failures detectable with proper validation including confidence

changes_required.title: Parallelism Control Service
changes_required.description: Implement task queue with configurable concurrency limits

acceptance_criteria.description: max_concurrent_tasks (default 5) enforced across run
Optional max_concurrent_per_scope for scope isolation
prefer_sequential_in_scope option respects scope ordering
TaskQueue service manages ready tasks with limits
getNextReadyTasks() respects parallelism config

changes_required.research_basis: Resource contention and cascading failures reduced with controlled parallelism

changes_required.title: Model Routing Rules
changes_required.description: Add complexity-to-model routing logic that Tuner can configure

acceptance_criteria.description: CliConfig extended with model field (haiku, sonnet, opus)
Model selection rules: condition -> model mapping
Default rules: trivial -> haiku, complex -> sonnet, architecture -> opus
selectModelForTask(task) applies rules from config
Model selection logged as trajectory event

changes_required.research_basis: SWE-bench: Opus 80.9%, Sonnet 64.8%, Haiku 60.6% - Haiku 3.7x cost efficient per success

changes_required.title: Dependency Resolution Enhancement
changes_required.description: Track input/output contracts between tasks for better dependency management

acceptance_criteria.description: Task has optional input_artifacts and output_artifacts arrays
Dependency validation checks artifact availability
Blocked tasks track which artifact is missing
getReadyTasks() validates artifact dependencies

changes_required.title: Tuner Outcome Emission
changes_required.description: Emit TaskOutcome and RunOutcome to Tuner for adaptive learning

acceptance_criteria.description: After task completes, build TaskOutcome with: model_used, duration, tokens, cost, outcome, confidence
After run completes, build RunOutcome with aggregate metrics
TunerClient.recordTaskOutcome() called fire-and-forget

changes_required.title: Tuner Config Reading

acceptance_criteria.description: Forge reads TUNER_URL from env (optional)
If TUNER_URL set, fetches ForgeExecutionConfig on startup

changes_required.description: Store detailed execution metrics for learning and analysis

acceptance_criteria.description: task_execution_metrics table with: task_id, model_id, duration_ms, tokens, cost, outcome
Metrics captured on task completion (success or failure)
Queryable by model, task_type, complexity for analysis
Pruning strategy to prevent unbounded growth

changes_required.description: Enforce per-task timeouts with graceful cancellation

acceptance_criteria.description: Per-task timeout from ExecutionPolicy.budgets.per_task_time_seconds

steps.title: Define ExecutionPolicy Zod schema and types
steps.description: Add ExecutionPolicy schema with budgets, retry, parallelism, replan, and confidence sub-schemas to domain/types.ts. This is the foundational type all other features depend on.

acceptance_criteria.description: ExecutionPolicySchema exported with all 5 sub-schemas (budgets, retry, parallelism, replan, confidence)
BudgetsConfig: { per_task_time_seconds: number, per_task_token_limit: number, total_cost_limit_usd: number }
RetryConfig: { max_retries_per_task: number (default 3), backoff: 'none'|'linear'|'exponential', backoff_base_seconds: number (default 30), include_failure_analysis: boolean (default true) }
ParallelismConfig: { max_concurrent_tasks: number (default 5), max_concurrent_per_scope?: number, prefer_sequential_in_scope: boolean (default false) }
ReplanConfig: { on_cascade_failure: boolean, threshold_blocked_tasks: number (default 3) }
ConfidenceConfig: { escalation_threshold: number (default 0.3), review_threshold: number (default 0.5) }
All configs use .default() for sensible defaults matching current behavior

architecture.pattern: Zod schema with nested object composition

design.note: Defaults chosen to match current Forge behavior (no limits enforced)

createRun() accepts optional ExecutionPolicy parameter
Existing runs without execution_policy continue to work (backwards compatible)

Index on (run_id, created_at DESC) for time-series queries
Index on (model_id, outcome) for model performance analysis
Schema added to ALL_SCHEMA_STATEMENTS array

steps.title: Create BudgetService class
steps.description: Implement BudgetService that tracks and enforces token/time/cost budgets per task and per run. Core orchestration knob.

acceptance_criteria.description: BudgetService class with constructor(storage, trajectoryCapture)
initBudget(runId, executionPolicy) initializes run_budgets row
recordUsage(taskId, { tokens, cost, duration }) updates run budget and emits trajectory event
checkBudget(runId) returns { ok: boolean, remaining: BudgetRemaining, warning_level: 'none'|'warning'|'critical' }
Warning at 80% usage, critical at 95% usage
Budget exhaustion triggers configured action via callback: (action: 'pause'|'abort'|'warn') => void

steps.title: Create TaskQueue service for parallelism control
steps.description: Implement TaskQueue service that manages ready tasks with configurable concurrency limits. Replaces direct task scheduling.

acceptance_criteria.description: TaskQueue class with constructor(parallelismConfig)
getNextReadyTasks(allReadyTasks, currentRunningCount) returns subset respecting limits
max_concurrent_tasks (default 5) enforced globally
max_concurrent_per_scope enforced when specified
prefer_sequential_in_scope orders tasks within scope by step_id when true
Returns empty array when limits reached

design.algorithm: Filter by global limit, then by scope limit, then order by preference

steps.title: Extend RecoveryService with strategy ladder
steps.description: Enhance recovery.ts to support multiple recovery strategies beyond simple retry: revise, rollback, branch, escalate, skip.

acceptance_criteria.description: RecoveryStrategy type: 'retry'|'revise'|'rollback'|'branch'|'escalate'|'skip'
handleTaskFailure(task, error, executionPolicy) selects and executes strategy
retry: Current behavior - retry with exponential backoff
revise: Retry with failure context prepended to prompt (Reflexion pattern)
escalate: Create human gate after max retries exhausted
Backoff uses config: backoff_base_seconds * 2^attempt for exponential
include_failure_analysis flag controls whether error context is added to revise prompts

security.note: Failure context sanitized before injection into prompt

steps.title: Implement confidence threshold handling
steps.description: Add confidence-based control flow to retrospective-service.ts. Low confidence triggers failure or clarification.

acceptance_criteria.description: processConfidence(taskId, confidence, executionPolicy) evaluates thresholds
confidence < escalation_threshold (default 0.3) returns { action: 'fail', reason: 'confidence_too_low' }
confidence < review_threshold (default 0.5) returns { action: 'clarify', reason: 'confidence_needs_review' }
confidence >= review_threshold returns { action: 'continue' }
Low confidence events captured as trajectory event: confidence_threshold_triggered
Integrated with existing retrospective capture flow

steps.title: Implement timeout enforcement in health-monitor
steps.description: Add per-task timeout enforcement to health-monitor.ts. Timeout triggers task failure with graceful agent shutdown.

acceptance_criteria.description: startTaskTimer(taskId, timeoutSeconds, onTimeout) starts timer for task
clearTaskTimer(taskId) cancels timer on task completion
onTimeout callback signals agent process (SIGTERM) for graceful shutdown
If agent doesn't exit within 10s grace period, SIGKILL sent
Timeout triggers task failure with outcome: 'timeout'
Timeout event captured as trajectory event: task_timeout
